hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — 7, 7, King. You bet. Your opponent raised you back.

wrongReasons: J 8 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with J 8.
6 2 makes a flush here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
9 K makes a full house here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 3 9

Your opponent flopped three of a kind and raised the flop immediately to build the pot. Sets are too strong to slow-play — they pushed their advantage on every street.
